[[High Inquisitor Toriimo]] is the person designated by [[Confessor Isaiah]] to lead the [[White Mantle inquisition|inquisitors]].

Previously a subordinate of [[Justiciar Hablion]] as a [[Justiciar Toriimo|justiciar]] himself, [[High Inquisitor Toriimo]] guarded the gates to [[Lion's Arch]] during the [[undead]] invasion.
